title: Framework PR #42 evidence documents retained stale exact-head claims
observed_behavior: The paired record correctly described the historical e056 CPython 3.14 migration failure but still stated that the security-preserving follow-up's exact head, hosted evidence, and resulting-master evidence were pending. Before the paired-record correction, exact source head 2930e04e1558b5b10bdeb87a76abb077a2085566 had already passed hosted python-ci-security-quality run 29962792445/job 89067507532, repaired OSV, all non-skipped PR checks, and the PR SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate. After that correction, the separate existing GitHub PR #42 description still called 2930e04 the required exact merge head although later documentation-reconciliation commit dc6cf411e78b3f37f1e4be52edef59894560b1ae was the published current head with successful visible Actions and PR Sonar evidence. The retained post-merge receipt now proves that PR #42 merged normally at 2026-07-23T07:41:13Z as Framework master/merge commit 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8, but the Change Record in that merged tree still says resulting-master evidence is unobserved and PR #42 has not merged. This is a newly reproduced factual documentation drift.
expected_behavior: The English/German Change Record pair and bilingual GitHub PR description distinguish historical source-head evidence from the current exact PR head and resulting-master evidence, bind every hosted claim to the observed SHA, preserve limitations for later heads and master, and, once resulting-master evidence exists, accurately record its exact SHA-bound result rather than call it unobserved.
impact: The stale wording could mislead a master-integration reviewer about evidence already observed for PR #42 or cause older-head evidence to be treated as current-head evidence. The newly reproduced merged-record assertion can also falsely report a completed merge/result as absent. It is a P2 documentation/evidence-quality defect and does not prove a product vulnerability, runtime change, or authorization to merge.
preconditions: At the original PR-scope reproduction, Framework PR #42 was open and its source follow-up head 2930e04e1558b5b10bdeb87a76abb077a2085566 had retained hosted evidence.
The paired Change Record is part of the PR's versioned documentation.
The existing bilingual GitHub PR description is part of the PR's current delivery evidence.
PR #42 has been normally merged as Framework master/merge commit 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 and the exact post-merge receipt is retained.
reproduction: Inspect the pre-correction identity, commands/results, checks-not-run, limitations, and final-review sections of the paired Change Record.
Compare its pending hosted-head claim with GitHub Actions run 29962792445/job 89067507532 and the retained PR #42 hosted verification receipt.
Read the pre-correction PR #42 Security and delivery boundary sections and compare their 2930e04 merge-head claim with the published dc6cf411 current head.

Read the Change Record as merged at 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 and compare its still-unobserved resulting-master/unmerged-PR statements with the retained post-merge verification receipt.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped Change Record diff review, make check-documentation, git diff --check, exact branch/PR head readback, and current GitHub/Sonar check readback
GitHub App current PR metadata/body read followed by task-owned bilingual pull-request-description update and current-state readback
RTK-wrapped GitHub PR/ref/commit/workflow/check-suite readback, SonarQube Cloud project-analysis/Quality-Gate readback, and Parent/Framework/MRTS status readback
make check-documentation; GitHub merge/tree and PR #50 path-comparison readback

root_cause: The original Change Record was authored before the final source follow-up reached hosted validation and was not reconciled after its exact-head checks passed; the first reconciliation corrected only the paired versioned records and left the independently editable GitHub PR description stale. After the normal PR #42 merge, the resulting-master state was likewise not reconciled in the already merged Change Record.
proposed_remediation: A separately authorized Framework documentation-only follow-up must update the paired Change Record to retain historical source-head evidence, bind the actual normal PR #42 merge/result to 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8, and preserve the unresolved SonarQube Cloud/Cloudflare limitations without calling either passing or resolved. Validate, review, merge, and recheck that follow-up normally. Do not alter source behavior, tests, controls, Quality Gates, merge permissions, Parent, or MRTS. The current task is tracking-only and authorizes no product-source change, Framework branch, or Framework pull request.
acceptance_criteria: The English and German Change Records carry equivalent facts, exact SHA values, run/job IDs, status boundaries, and limitations.
The record identifies hosted source-head evidence as observed and binds the actual resulting-master result to 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 rather than calling it unobserved.
The record makes no claim beyond the exact documentation-reconciliation or resulting-master evidence that is retained.
The PR description identifies 2930e04 as historical evidence and dc6cf411 as the current head in equivalent English and German.
make check-documentation and git diff --check pass for the paired correction.
A separately authorized correction is normally committed and pushed in its own Framework PR; no direct master push, Parent gitlink update, or MRTS change occurs.
A separately authorized Framework documentation follow-up is normally reviewed, validated, merged, and rechecked on its resulting master before this finding can become verified or closed.
validation_plan: Review the paired diff and run git diff --check.
Run make check-documentation with an explicitly selected Framework interpreter and task-owned external state/build roots.
Commit and normally push only the paired Change Record files, then confirm local, remote, and PR head SHA equality.
Collect fresh exact-head PR evidence without substituting it for resulting-master evidence.
Read back the corrected GitHub PR description and confirm that its head is unchanged.
Compare the merged Change Record at exact master 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 with the hash-addressed post-merge verification receipt.
For a separately authorized follow-up only, rerun documentation checks, exact-head validation, normal merge, and resulting-master reproduction.
regression_tests: GitHub Actions and SonarQube Cloud exact-head readback for PR #42
legitimate_control_tests: Both records retain the direct-master-push prohibition and require fresh exact-head evidence for every later PR head.
The record must distinguish observed resulting-master evidence from the still-unresolved SonarQube Cloud and Cloudflare limits.
The corrected PR body preserves queued Cloudflare and current-master Sonar delivery limitations.
evidence_limitations: The correction and exact current PR head were verified at PR scope only before the later normal merge.
The post-merge receipt proves one exact resulting Framework master state but does not prove that the stale merged Change Record has been corrected.

The resulting-master SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate is ERROR only for new_security_rating C, and its Cloudflare suite is queued with no check runs; the bounded PR #42 acceptance does not make either condition passing, resolved, or globally closed.
No product source, Framework branch, or Framework pull request is authorized by the current tracking task.
residual_risk: The paired Change Record correction was normally merged by Framework PR #50 and passed resulting-master documentation validation. Separate global SonarQube Cloud and Cloudflare records remain independently unresolved and are not closed by this documentation disposition.
